out_of_time_repeatability.evaluation_threshold: Train >= 150 High-Pressure Balls, Test >= 60 High-Pressure Balls

batters.signal_interpretation: Modest repeatability. 95% CI spans zero; historical efficiency under pressure is not a rigid predictive trait.

bowlers.signal_interpretation: Modest repeatability. 95% CI strictly positive but modest. Rank orders are closely tied and best viewed as confidence tiers.

dropped_experiments.reason: Degraded out-of-time correlation (rho collapsed from +0.25 to -0.004 for batters, and from +0.31 to +0.10 for bowlers) due to Bernoulli wicket noise.
dropped_experiments.disposition: Dropped. Score uses pure run efficiency; dismissals reported as diagnostic column only.

dropped_experiments.reason: Favored low-volume outliers and middle-overs spinners without adjusting for venue, phase, or opponent strength.
dropped_experiments.disposition: Dropped. Replaced by empirical Bayes shrunk opposition-adjusted rates.

dropped_experiments.reason: Innings 1 had zero high-pressure deliveries because pre-match win probability starts near 50% and swings less in Innings 1 than chasing in Innings 2.
dropped_experiments.disposition: Dropped. Adopted within-innings percentile standardization (top third in each innings).
